headline: Rail link to North Bengal cut after Neelsagar Express derails in Tangail
summary: The last carriage of the train derailed near Mohera station, leaving multiple trains stranded and disrupting travel to the northern region.
details: The last carriage of the Neelsagar Express (765), traveling from Dhaka to Nilphamari, derailed near Mohera railway station in Mirzapur, Tangail.
The incident occurred around 9:10 AM on Thursday, October 29. According to Station Master Rakibul Islam, the rear part of the final carriage went off the tracks.
While the derailment caused slight damage to the wheels and the rail line, no casualties or injuries were reported.
The accident has completely suspended rail communication between Dhaka and North Bengal, leaving several trains stranded at various stations.
A relief train has been dispatched to recover the derailed carriage. Railway authorities stated that the line will be restored to normal as soon as the recovery operation is complete.

headline_marked: Tk 30,000 salary demand: [[Garment workers block road]] in Mirpur
headline: Tk 30,000 salary demand: Garment workers block road in Mirpur
summary: Hundreds of workers have brought traffic to a standstill at Mirpur-10, demanding a higher minimum monthly wage.
details: Several hundred garment workers from various nearby factories blocked roads in Dhaka's Mirpur-10 starting at 10am on Thursday.
The protesters are demanding a minimum monthly salary of Tk 30,000.
The blockade caused severe traffic congestion in Mirpur-10 and surrounding areas, forcing many commuters to walk to their destinations.
Hasan Mohammad Naser Rikabder, Deputy Commissioner of Police for the Mirpur Division, confirmed that police are attempting to convince the workers to clear the road.
The Mirpur Traffic Division reported via Facebook that traffic was temporarily disrupted at the Mirpur Roundabout No. 10 due to the protest.
